lesson: The system is consistently entering trades against the prevailing momentum, specifically attempting to fade blow-off tops or pick bottoms during high-velocity impulses. By ignoring the lack of structural confirmation (CHoCH or BOS) and relying on overextended indicators, the strategy is being liquidated by volatility expansion.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'No-Trade' zone during periods of extreme RSI divergence until a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Upthrust is validated by a secondary test on the 1h timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust momentum indicators less; prioritize SMC structural breaks over oscillator-based mean reversion.
